spans.s: N. of the author of the Mugdha-bodha grammar (also of the Kavi-kalpadruma and various other works, including, according to some, the Bhāgavata-Purāṇa; he was a son of Keśava and pupil of Dhaneśvara, and is said to have flourished about the latter half of the thirteenth century at the court of Hemādri, king of Deva-giri, now Dowlatābād).
वोप-देव—शतक n. N. of a Kāvya by Vopa-deva.
or वोपालित-सिंह m. N. of a lexicographer, Cat.
